description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://www.blizzard.com/bpmn/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CharacterCreation" name="Character creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start two things">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Names</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Account</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Names</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Names_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBnetAccount" name="Check battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Account</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetExists" name="Battle.net account exists?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetExists_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetExists_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BnetExists_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterAccount_ClickLink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click link in confirmation mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterAccount_ClickLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClickLink_BnetReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetReady" name="Battle.net account ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BnetExists_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClickLink_BnetReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetReady_CheckSub</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWowSubscription" name="Check active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BnetReady_CheckSub</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckSub_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubActive" name="WoW subscription active?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckSub_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubActive_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubActive_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubActive_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Payment method?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BankSplit" name="Enter bank details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Bank</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Iban</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Bic</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIbanNumber" name="Enter IBAN number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Iban</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Iban_BankJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBicNumber" name="Enter BIC number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Bic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bic_BankJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_BankJoin" name="Bank details entered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Iban_BankJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bic_BankJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankJoin_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Subscription and payment settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubActive_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankJoin_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin" name="Account set up and names prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Names_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_SelectRealm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRealm" name="Select realm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_SelectRealm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Realm_SelectRace</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRace" name="Select race">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Realm_SelectRace</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Race_SelectClass</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectClass" name="Select class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Race_SelectClass</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Class_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Class_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameTaken_Retry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_Available</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_Available</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameTaken_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm_Selfies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveSelfies" name="Receive character selfies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm_Selfies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selfies_Expansion</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selfies_Expansion</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Expansion_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Character created and expansion notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Expansion_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_CharacterCreation" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Names" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Account" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BnetExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetExists_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetExists" targetRef="Gateway_BnetReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetExists_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAccount_ClickLink" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_BnetReady" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BnetReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetReady_CheckSub" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetReady" targetRef="Task_CheckWowSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSub_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckWowSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubActive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubActive_Yes" name="Active" sourceRef="Gateway_SubActive" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Bank" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_BankSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Iban" sourceRef="Gateway_BankSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterIbanNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Bic" sourceRef="Gateway_BankSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterBicNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Iban_BankJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterIbanNumber" targetRef="Gateway_BankJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bic_BankJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterBicNumber" targetRef="Gateway_BankJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankJoin_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_BankJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInfo" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Names_Join" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_SelectRealm" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectRealm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Realm_SelectRace" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealm" targetRef="Task_SelectRace"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Race_SelectClass" sourceRef="Task_SelectRace" targetRef="Task_SelectClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Class_EnterName" sourceRef="Task_SelectClass" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_Available" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken_Retry" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_Confirm" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Selfies" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selfies_Expansion" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expansion_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
